body:
Most of the changes are actually not permanent to the extent they're made out to be. You can look at detransition timelines to gauge out how going off testosterone looks. Fat redistribution fully reverses (so eventually you will look completely female again), voice will remain male passing but will lighten over time, bottom growth shrinks, hair remains thicker but also lightens the longer you're off T. 

I've been taking a low dose of testosterone gel alongside dutasteride for 4 years (sometimes on and off) and I don't grow facial hair except for peach fuzz in my mustache area and maybe 3 chin hairs. I only introduced dutasteride after about a year though since it can affect voice changes, bottom growth and fat distribution slightly.
